test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

ACNE - CANE - ENCA

INCH - NICH - HCNI
solution:
The logic followed here is:

ACNE - CANE - ENCA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9acadb50bf6091bbf6f334d132ae35ef5a7ae8be2e3073d01e8dfcf096100afe.png] 

INCH - NICH - HCNI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7ded7ead3d52f1ffdeaf5e00ff76084244d5d6eb8c2681c2afb0211a83bcce2.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. LADY - ALDY - YDAL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce6359b3f7de2c60d4c9239fcd99d3785a40fe426464828031ea1d2db1c94c60.png] 

2. QUAD - QAUD - DAUQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67cacb27fbd45b6f7674e947ff56a3762a5a095748162ca9f356a3045965157b.png] 

3. GIRL - IGRL - LIRG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a77e184bb3ffde136dc86736388c938356029d5aefc4f9ed8c54fa3282c4423d.png] 

4. RAKE - ARKE - AKER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74eb6cda111b9e0ffba6b876832978ab80ac2a4b4ae4664c258b9b0036fdd498.png] 

Thus, 'LADY - ALDY - YDAL' follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
